races.paceDynamic: Hurricane Bay and No But I Will will clash early as both confirmed front-runners, with Hurricane Bay's superior class (OR 120) likely giving him the edge in the lead battle. Their duel will create a genuine pace that should suit the hold-up horses in the field, particularly given the 3m trip allows time for tactical positioning. Mt Fugi Park and Giovanni Change will track the leaders prominently while Knockanore and Ladronne drop in behind. This sustained gallop over 3 miles strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can time their challenge late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Hurricane Bay and No But I Will engage in a prolonged battle from the 2nd mile onwards
scenarios.body: The pace will become unsustainable for the leaders, setting up perfect conditions for the patient hold-up runners. Knockanore and Ladronne, despite their claims 7lb advantage, can sweep past tired front-runners in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders drops out early, allowing a more conservative pace
scenarios.body: Mt Fugi Park or Giovanni Change can sit closer to a steadier gallop and have enough left to outgun the hold-up horses. Their prominent position gives them first run when the pace lifts approaching the final mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Hurricane Bay gets an uncontested lead with No But I Will settling behind
scenarios.body: The superior OR 120 runner can dictate terms and kick clear when it matters, using his class advantage. His recent form shows he can handle these tactics when not pressed too hard early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with both leaders pulling up or falling
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 2 out, suiting whichever horse has been given the quietest ride. This chaos scenario opens the door for any of the field to capitalise on others' misfortune.
